INFO 01Border Readiness

Visa & Entry Preparation Dossier

Essential pre-departure checklists and official links to the Singapore Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA). Prepare your travel documents with clarity.

PORTAL: SINGAPORE IMMIGRATION & CHECKPOINTS AUTHORITY·ICA PORTAL: ICA.GOV.SG
Legal & Immigration Authority Disclaimer

Entry requirements into Singapore depend entirely upon passport nationality, travel purpose, and border authority discretion. Roamora is an independent travel publication and planning prototype; we do not determine visa eligibility, grant approvals, or guarantee entry. Always consult the official ICA portal directly before departure.

VISA-001MODULE 01

Singapore entry planning checklist

Target: international visitors
Checklist Steps (5):
  1. 1
    Check passport validity and airline or onward-destination requirements.
  2. 2
    Use the official ICA visa requirements guidance to determine whether a visa is needed for your passport.
  3. 3
    Check current SG Arrival Card requirements and submission window.
  4. 4
    Prepare accommodation, onward travel and purpose-of-visit details if requested.
  5. 5
    Recheck official requirements shortly before departure.
Official Sources:Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA)

Note: Requirements change; this is not an eligibility decision or guarantee of entry.

VISA-002MODULE 02

SG Arrival Card awareness

Target: visitors for whom the requirement applies
Checklist Steps (4):
  1. 1
    Read current ICA instructions.
  2. 2
    Submit through the official channel within the current allowed window.
  3. 3
    Keep the acknowledgement if provided.
  4. 4
    Do not confuse the SG Arrival Card with a visa.
Official Sources:ICA official website

Note: Confirm the current requirement directly with ICA.

VISA-003MODULE 03

Travelling onward from Singapore

Target: visitors continuing to another country
Checklist Steps (4):
  1. 1
    Check the next destination's official immigration website.
  2. 2
    Confirm transit visa rules for every itinerary segment.
  3. 3
    Check passport validity and onward-ticket requirements.
  4. 4
    Verify airline document checks before departure.
Official Sources:Singapore ICA

Note: The onward destination's authorities determine entry rules.

Key Reminder: SG Arrival Card (SGAC) with Electronic Health Declaration

All travellers (including Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents returning from abroad) must complete the SG Arrival Card within 3 calendar days before arrival in Singapore. It is free of charge on the official ICA website or the MyICA Mobile App. Beware of unauthorized third-party commercial portals that charge fees for this submission.
